definitions.gloss: pickup; going to meet someone; welcoming a guest
definitions.explanation: The act of going to meet or pick someone up — most often a child from daycare/school, or a guest arriving from elsewhere. Polite form of {迎|むか}え with the honorific お-.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{迎|むか}え⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'm going to pick up the kids.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧お{迎|むか}え⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参|まい}ります→参る：01322_mairu⟧。
examples.english: I will come to meet you at the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{保育園|ほいくえん}→保育園：04704_hoikuen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{迎|むか}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遅|おく}れない→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつけている→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I make sure not to be late for the daycare pickup time.

notes:
Polite noun form of the verb ⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ (to meet, to welcome). The opposite of ⟦{見送|みおく}り→見送り：03742_miokuri⟧ (seeing someone off).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{迎|むか}え⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to meet/pick up
- お{迎|むか}え⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: to come to meet/pick up
- お{迎|むか}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: pickup time
- お{迎|むか}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧: pickup car
- ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{迎|むか}え: airport pickup

USAGE: Standard daily-life vocabulary, especially for parents with children in daycare. Polite enough for business contexts when offering to meet a guest at a station or airport.

EUPHEMISTIC USE: お{迎|むか}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ ('the one who comes to meet has come') is a softened way to refer to death — typically pictured as a Buddhist or divine figure coming to escort the deceased.
